name: third-class-sampler
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Twenty-odd skills from a third-class redesign, one class at a time, on the skill IDs the classes already have: passives with caps and stacks, a shield, a decoy, a spell that is stored and released, a field that echoes, crafting under a shared cap, and more. A worked example of the Lua hooks, queries and actions for reworking whole classes.
